summary: Immunic, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a reverse stock split approved at a special meeting. The board set a 1-for-10 ratio; the Certificate of Amendment was filed on April 22, 2026. Outstanding shares drop from ~136M to ~13.6M. No fractional shares are issued; the transfer agent will aggregate and sell fractions. The new CUSIP is 4525EP200; the symbol remains IMUX. This is a routine corporate action for Nasdaq listing compliance, not a special situation. There is no deal, no premium, and no acquisition or restructuring event.
